newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia raises 28.365 mln dinars in bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia raises 28.365 mln dinars in bond issue.

text.p: The Tunisian Treasury on Tuesday said it has raised 28.365 million dinars from November's issue of treasury bonds negotiable at the bourse (BTNB).
It said it has sold 10-year bonds worth 25.865 million dinars at 10.5 percent and five-year paper worth 2.5 million dinars at 9.5 percent.
BTNB are issued each month on the first Tuesday. ($=0.98 dinar)
